messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2: cannot allocate vector of size 1.9 Gb
parts: I loaded UsingR on a 32-bit computer without an issue. Do you have lots of other applications open, which are using lots of RAM ? Loading that package uses only 268 MB. It's easy to run if you do not have much RAM already reserved by programs other than R.
